target.title: refactor(models): remove redundant generation model ref alias
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The media-generation model-ref module exposes a redundant named type for the same provider/model shape already owned by `ProviderModelRef`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Return `ProviderModelRef` directly from `parseGenerationModelRef` and remove the unused alias. This keeps one canonical type without changing runtime behavior or supported plugin SDK entrypoints.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. Internal model-reference typing has one fewer duplicate name.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/media-generation-core/src/model-ref.test.ts` — 5 tests passed.
- `corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw/media-generation-core build` — passed on Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox (`tbx_01kwq90wnvc6nf78e34sgybe4v`, Actions run `28716902914`).
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --prompt-file /tmp/model-ref-alias-review-evidence.md --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
